propositions: reconcile_check.py currently performs vendor-shape comparison via ad-hoc by-path loads of Jira-specific adapters (outbound_fields, adf) and custom unwrap logic, violating backend neutrality

The snapshot assignee comparison, description normalization, and status/priority unwrapping must be canonicalized using the backend's InboundMapper and OutboundMapper to eliminate direct vendor reach-through
Description comparison must use OutboundMapper.map_fields_to_remote for ADF-fitting (without logger.warning) and rstrip-tolerant text matching, mirroring the canonical differ's parity rule
The reported jira_value in discrepancy records remains the raw snapshot payload (opaque vendor data passed through untouched)
A ticket with rebar-status annotation labels now reconciles to the annotation-mapped local status (correctness improvement), whereas raw comparison previously mis-flagged it
The AC1 neutrality gate must detect both adapters.jira imports (AST walker) and adapters/jira/ path literals (source-text scan) to prevent future sibling vendor loads
